_comment: Each canary type needs three fields:
placeholder        – the true private value to rank
conversation       – the full message list, exactly as fed to apply_chat_template during training
placeholder_marker – a unique substring inside one of the messages that marks
WHERE the placeholder sits. Must appear EXACTLY ONCE
across all messages. The script replaces this marker with
each candidate to render 10,001 sequences for ranking.
Wrap it in distinctive characters (e.g. <...>) so it
cannot accidentally collide with real content.
